blocks.text: The Waking World Is Just One Department.

blocks.text: Specifically, the relevant form of jñāna is cognition of the externally presented world.

blocks.text: There’s a gecko on the wall looking suspiciously like he owns the property.

blocks.text: Everything appears organised into objects apprehended through the senses.

blocks.text: But do not confuse the waking state’s relative clarity with ultimate awakening.

blocks.text: You can be wide awake physically and completely unaware of your own fundamental nature.
blocks.directed: You can be wide awake physically and completely unaware of your own fundamental nature.

blocks.text: You’re analysing interest rates and arguing about whether somebody has used a Sanskrit compound correctly.
blocks.directed: You’re analysing interest rates and arguing about whether somebody has used a Sanskrit compound correctly.

blocks.text: And the whole time, the consciousness in which all these things are appearing remains unrecognised.
